reviews.t: Great for thick, coarse hair co-wash
reviews.x: This is the third conditioning bar I've tried for co-washing my extra thick, coarse, wavy hair, and this is the one I'm sticking with.  It has a conventional round "bar" shape that fits in the palm of your hand, so it's easy to apply to a lot of hair in the shower.  It has a pleasant, light scent that is not overwhelming.  The formula is substantial enough to use as a co-wash.  And it is eco-friendly!  Highly recommend for fellow big-hair folks.

reviews.x: I have always needed TONS of product to keep my hair from being fizzy. But this conditioner bar is amazing! I use it in the shower comb through my hair and that is that! I was happy to ditch my shampoo and conditioner that were in plastic bottles for bars but really didn't think I would ever be able to stop using my curl cream (in plastic)...happily I was wrong!! I am amazed.

Having tried bar shampoo from Lush and not liking it many years ago, I did not have high hopes. I chose this brand because the price was reasonable for a gamble and I liked the ingredient list well enough.  Turns out,  I LOVE IT. reviews.t: Really great product for frizzy hair
reviews.x: I don't love the smell. It's not that it's bad,just different.  Natural smelling. The important thing is that it doesn't linger and it leaves hair soft and curls and waves without frizz. I have salt n pepper hair and grey hair is textured different.  This helps. I use it as a leave in conditioner.  I use my shower comb in the shower in combat with this conditioner and I'm super happy with the results.

This is my first go around with bars and I find the conditioner is a little difficult to apply but I’m sure it  will be something I’ll get used too. Once I get enough in my hair I find it’s the perfect amount of moisture. claims.text: Many reviewers with curly, wavy, or frizz-prone hair say it controls frizz and leaves hair soft and manageable.
Several reviewers find it works well for thick or coarse hair, though some note it can be difficult to apply or rinse out.
Reviewers frequently praise it as a great alternative to bottled products, especially for travel and reducing plastic.
Opinions on the scent are mixed, with some liking it and others finding it unpleasant or different.
A few reviewers report negative results, such as hair feeling greasy or unwashed.
